question: Who among the following won the prestigious Abhinandan Saroja National Award 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is** __Aparna Satheesan.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Aparna Satheesan,** is among India's most dynamic and technically brilliant dancers, an outstanding representative of Kuchipudi dance form. 
 
• **Abhinandan Saroja National Award** is a national award given to eminent dancers for their choreography, performance and contribution to preserving the traditional classical dance forms of India.
 
• It is presented by the National Institute of Indian Classical Dance.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b681f78dd7bacecb228063ddab3637a118ca58cb0ee2aed86a1766159702eb15.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• **Saroja Vaidyanathan **i__s a choreographer, the most intellectual soul, the guru, and a notable exponent of Bharatanatyam. She was conferred the Padma Shri in 2002 and the Padma Bhushan in 2013 by the Government of India.
 
• **Mrinalini Sarabhai **was the founder and director of the **Darpana Academy of Performing Arts.**
 
• Alarmel Valli is a leading Indian classical dancer and choreographer and the foremost exponent of the Pandanallur style.
